name: party
title: PARTY synth engine (Yamaha PSS-11: the GEW7 AWM tone generator, recreated)
summary: Pick PARTY in the engine list or the 'party' preset: the Yamaha PortaSound PSS-11's AWM tone generator (GEW7) recreated after MAME's gew.cpp / gew7.cpp (BSD-3, see NOTICE): its 8- and 12-bit samples played as stored, per-sample envelope (attack, decay 1, decay level, decay 2, key scaling, 96 dB exponential level) and LFO (vibrato, tremolo, reverse start), tested against MAME's per-chip-sample code. Two layers (A/B), mix, low-pass filter with envelope, resonance, key tracking, A decay and B fade-in, bank on shift + blue turn; a live PARTY keyboard screen (voice list, knob, buttons, keys lit as they sound) above the STATION 1-style parameter rows. No Yamaha data ships: without a ROM dump it plays 8 own built-in waves; gen_pss11.py --pss-rom turns the user's own PSS-11/21/31 or PSR-75 ROM (xl437a00.ic4) into a library of every sample-table sound. Sample data is a content file loaded into TE's sample memory, not the SDK region.
controls: engine list: PARTY; preset browser: folder party (one preset, 'party'); sounds: shift + blue turn (8 built-in, or every ROM sample-table sound S000..)
PARTY sound: knob push cycles page 1 (WAVE A WAVE B MIX CUTOFF) / 2 (B PITCH DETUNE F.ENV F.DECAY) / 3 (RES KEY TRK A DECAY B FADE) / 4 (FX knobs)

sql: INSERT INTO synth_types (id, type, default_params) SELECT MAX(id) + 1, 'party', '[81,  81,  0,  16383,  4096,  4096,  4096,  4096]' FROM synth_types
